videos.title: Design Patterns For Complex Apps and Workflows
videos.why: Two design principles for supporting the complex, repetitive workflows that desktop tools are used for.

videos.title: Exploring the Fluent Design System
videos.why: A Microsoft designer explains why Fluent was created for Windows, how it supports different ways of interacting across devices, and how it compares with Material Design.

podcasts.why: Two long-time Apple app reviewers on the trade-offs of apps built with web technology, with examples they like and a few they do not.

podcasts.episode: Inside Linear: Building with taste, craft, and focus | Karri Saarinen (co-founder, designer, CEO)
podcasts.why: The designer and co-founder of Linear, a fast, keyboard-driven work tool, on prioritising craft and quality in software people use all day.

reads.title: Designing for macOS
reads.why: What sets the Mac apart, such as large displays, long sessions of focused work, several apps open at once and many input methods, and the best practices that follow.

reads.title: 8 Design Guidelines for Complex Applications
reads.why: Guidelines for dense, data-heavy tools, such as helping people track their work across workspaces and reducing clutter without reducing capability.

reads.title: How to build a remarkable command palette
reads.why: How a Cmd+K command palette lets people do any action quickly and learn its shortcut for next time, with the details that make one work well.
